updates.detailed_summary_zh: CNBC报道称，全天候永续合约交易的兴起使华尔街对加密衍生品的适应变得“紧迫”，并将永续合约形容为“24/7交易的强化版证券”。文章表明，传统交易模式必须适应全天候数字资产市场这一认识正在机构中增强。 永续合约是交易最活跃的加密衍生品，因此华尔街立场的任何结构性转变都可能影响数字资产的流动性、价格发现和波动性。这种紧迫感反映出传统交易所面临的竞争压力，以及加密原生市场基础设施日益增长的主流相关性。 永续合约没有到期日，依靠资金费率机制使合约价格锚定现货市场，允许交易者无限期持有杠杆头寸。CNBC的标题强调，这类产品如今对传统交易时间、清算和风险框架构成结构性挑战。
updates.detailed_summary_en: CNBC reports that the rise of 24/7 perpetual futures trading has made Wall Street's adjustment to crypto derivatives 'urgent,' framing perpetuals as a '24/7 security on steroids.' The article signals growing institutional recognition that traditional trading models must adapt to round-the-clock digital asset markets. Perpetual futures are the most actively traded crypto derivatives, so any structural shift in Wall Street's stance can influence liquidity, price discovery, and volatility across digital assets. The urgency reflects competitive pressure on traditional exchanges and the growing mainstream relevance of crypto-native market infrastructure. Perpetual futures have no expiration date and rely on a funding rate mechanism to keep contract prices anchored to spot markets, enabling leveraged positions that can be held indefinitely. The CNBC headline emphasizes that this product class now represents a structural challenge to conventional market hours, clearing, and risk frameworks.
